questions.prompt: In the loop, what makes the program stop and return an answer?
options: The model replies with a stop reason other than tool_use
The program has run one tool
The history has more than 3 messages
The tool returns an empty result
questions.explanation: The program stops only when the stop reason is not tool_use, because then the model answered in text and asked for nothing more.

questions.prompt: Why does the program send all 3 messages on the second request, not only the tool result?
options: The API rejects requests with a single message
The model is stateless, so it does not remember the first request
The tool result must come before the question
Sending more messages makes the model answer faster
questions.explanation: The model keeps nothing between requests. Without the question and its own tool call, the result 42 means nothing to it.

questions.prompt: In the cook and helper picture, which part decides which tool runs next?
options: The helper, which is your program
The recipe, which is the tool schema
The cook, which is the model
The kitchen, which is the API
questions.explanation: The model chooses every next action. The program only runs what the model asked for and reports the result.
